project.name: Luthrie
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Luthrie works as a walking base rather than a rounded destination. Strict-boundary score verified sequentially on 2026-09-02. Community coffee mornings are events, not a dependable daily café. Hall toilets are not represented as a public convenience.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Luthrie has a well-documented Norman’s Law route and a precise village-hall parking start, but no dependable daily café, public toilet or visitable attraction.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Verified outdoor routes can suit responsible dog visits, with close control around livestock, roads, wildlife and historic fabric.
